Room-level grid_ref values are approximate ranges (~) since no dimension line ties individual downlight symbols to exact grid points on this overview lighting plan -- interior room subdivisions within the 3.50m column bays are not dimensioned on this sheet (that detail lives on the architectural floor-plan sheet, outside this discipline's scope).
